conclusion: No concrete correctness defect identified in authored durable nullable flags increment. Runtime qualification remains required.

reviewed_invariants.result: Optional header flags default null. Codec preserves null distinctly from mask zero; SQL COALESCE retains prior flags when omitted, while zero clears all observed standard bits.

Existing exact account/id/remote collision checks precede upsert. Remote identity encoding includes mailbox and UIDVALIDITY; MailSyncPage validates IMAP mailbox ownership. Reset with new identity does not inherit old flag bits.
Flag mutation shares sync transaction with records, memberships, tombstones and cursor CAS. Fault/cancel prevents commit. Existing successful-commit stream publication is unchanged.

Immutable v1/v2 definitions retained. v1 runs v2 then v3; v2 runs v3 only. ALTER and user_version=3 occur in one explicit transaction; existing rows get NULL. Existing v2 FTS/index_state not recreated. Unknown source versions rejected.
Database CHECK permits only NULL or integer 0..31. Codec independently rejects out-of-range masks with fixed redacted error. Flags included in logical quota accounting.
All _header callers select message .* or SELECT *; search/watch/reindex/cache source projection can read flags. No Dart IO/Flutter dependency added to core.

Cases distinguish unknown/empty and exercise individual/all masks, identity conflict, reset isolation, rollback before cursor, search/watch, file reopen, preservation of drafts/outbox and existing FTS, failed v2 upgrade rollback, future-version rejection.
